answer: Weight each grader by a hidden honeypot score. Every epoch the beacon seeds 5% of seats with known-bad answers (a jade-colored apple called a mineral, a zenith placed below the horizon). A grader who passes one loses half its seat weight for 8 epochs; two misses zero it. Sybil clones that wander through seats rubber-stamping each other burn their weight fast, so a farm of 50 keys buys roughly the influence of one careful grader.
